$description: Calendar grid tokens. The day cell is sized and spaced here rather than by the grid, so a cell stays square and the focus ring has room — a ring drawn on a cell flush against its neighbours is clipped by them.

day-outside-color.$description: A day from a neighbouring month. Dimmed, not hidden: arrow keys have to land somewhere when you step off the edge of the month.

range-bg.$description: The days between the two ends of a range. Subtle rather than the base fill, so the two ENDS stay the thing the eye finds — a range painted one flat colour has no handles.

day-highlighted-color.$description: A day worth pointing at. Marked with a dot rather than a fill, because highlighted and SELECTED are different states and a reader has to be able to tell a suggestion from a choice.
